RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel does not indicate bias. In the civil service, selection panels are typically formed based on availability, role seniority, and domain relevance. The successful candidate has strong, relevant qualifications and international leadership experience, indicating a merit-based appointment. 

Furthermore, two weeks is a standard administrative turnaround time for detailed civil service feedback, not evidence of bad faith. Challenging the outcome based purely on the panel's gender composition is entirely unsubstantiated and could significantly harm your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up request focusing strictly on your interview performance, competency scores, and constructive feedback for future promotions.
